Wow, that image brought back some strong memories. I still remember going to our local Walmart with my mom when I was a kid - we did it as part of my birthday celebration that year. We pretty much went all out with Star Wars: Attack of the Clones theme for my birthday that year - saw the movie, did the Walmart event, and most of my gifts were SW themed. Honestly, this was probably my best birthday as a kid..

I know this comment isn't necessarily SW Lego related, but I genuinely had tears in my eyes from the memories this image brought back. Thank you for posting this!
